meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手改用 OpenCode 驱动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用命令行工具管理 AI 智能体
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to OpenCode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are managing AI agents via command line

howto.what: NanoClaw 会新增 OpenCode 作为 agent 后端选项。管理员可把某 agent 组的 provider 改为 opencode,该组的模型请求即经 OpenCode 转发到 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等第三方模型。
howto.when: 当 NanoClaw 中还没有 OpenCode 后端文件,而你想让某个 agent 组改用 OpenCode 支持的模型(如 DeepSeek、OpenRouter)时。

say.text: 切换 provider 后帮我跑 /migrate-memory 迁移记忆
say.note: 否则记忆不会自动带过去。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains OpenCode as an agent provider option. Admin can set a group's provider to opencode; that group's model calls then go through OpenCode to OpenRouter, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Google, etc.
howto.when_en: When you want a NanoClaw agent group to use OpenCode-backed models (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Google, etc.) instead of default Claude, and the OpenCode provider files are not yet present.

say_en.text: Switch agent group buyer's provider to opencode and restart it.
say_en.note: After this, the buyer group calls models via OpenCode.

say_en.text: Set up OpenCode to use OpenRouter's claude-sonnet-4.
After switching provider, run /migrate-memory to move memory over.
say_en.note: Memory won't carry over automatically otherwise.
